channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Bonehold
item.description: Dungeon Crawler with elements of rogue-like and ARPG games. Kill hordes of enemies, duel mighty bosses, and acquire legendary loot!

item.title: ENDLESS Legend™
item.description: ENDLESS Legend™ is a 4X turn-based fantasy strategy game by the creators of ENDLESS Space™ and Dungeon of the ENDLESS™. Control every aspect of your civilization as you struggle to save your homeworld Auriga. Create your own Legend!

item.title: Heroes of Hammerwatch II - Celestial Ruins
item.description: Take up the holy duties of the new Priest class and brave a fallen sanctum in the Celestial Ruins Expansion for Heroes of Hammerwatch II.

item.title: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight Deluxe Edition Upgrade
item.description: Become the Dark Knight and battle Gotham City’s most infamous DC Super-Villains in an open-world action-adventure from TT Games, the award-winning studio behind LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga.

item.title: LEGO® The Incredibles
item.description: Experience the thrilling adventures of the Parr family as they conquer crime and family life through both Disney-Pixar films The Incredibles and Incredibles 2, in a LEGO® world full of fun and humor.

item.title: My Infamous Dungeon
item.description: Be evil. Build your dungeon and grow your empire in this roguelite dungeon builder. Hire monsters, set traps, battle heroes, and conquer the overworld with an ever expanding legion of evil.

item.title: Psychonauts
item.description: A Psychic Odyssey Through the Minds of Misfits, Monsters, and Madmen. This classic action/adventure platformer from acclaimed developers Double Fine Productions follows the story of a young psychic named Razputin.

item.title: SCREAM NOTE
item.description: Jumpscare your friends. If you write your friend's name on a page, the monster jumpscares them and they scream. Co-op comedy horror where you and your friends are trapped in a haunted neighborhood house. Can you reach the exit together, or will you scare each other out? 222 unique, crazy jumpscares!

item.title: Space Imperia 4X
item.description: A faithful digital adaptation of the acclaimed board game Space Empires 4X by GMT Games, beloved by wargamers for almost two decades. Command the rise of your civilization and the fall of others, all in one to two hours.

item.title: Suncraft
item.description: Another sun-filled day begins in this cozy pixel-art adventure. Gather, craft, upgrade, and help the villagers revive the land. Can you rebuild the grand Sunspire and bring the village back to its golden days?

item.title: Chernobylite Complete Edition
item.description: Chernobylite is a science-fiction survival horror RPG. Set in the hyper-realistic, 3D-scanned wasteland of Chernobyl’s Exclusion Zone, explore a non-linear storyline in your search to uncover the truth of your tortured past.

item.title: E-Shop Tycoon
item.description: Embark on an e-commerce startup journey in E-Shop Tycoon! Optimize warehouse logistics, hire and train staff, and design unique office spaces as your business grows. Handle industry events and marketing crises. Come grow your startup into an e-commerce giant!

item.title: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™
item.description: Collect the best vehicles in the Hot Wheels™ universe, build spectacular tracks and dive into breathtaking races.

item.title: Le Mans Ultimate - US Track Pack 1
item.description: Le Mans Ultimate goes stateside for a brand new challenge! The first of 3 track packs with 6 new circuits includes 2 of the most iconic road circuit racing tracks in the US - including the world-famous Daytona International Speedway and WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca

item.title: LEGO® City Undercover
item.description: Join the Chase! In LEGO® CITY Undercover, play as Chase McCain, a police officer who's been tasked with going undercover to hunt down the notorious – and recently escaped – criminal Rex Fury and putting an end to his city-wide crime wave.

item.title: Red Faction Guerrilla Re-Mars-tered
item.description: Red Faction: Guerrilla re-defines the limits of destruction-based game-play with a huge open-world, fast-paced guerrilla-style combat, and true physics-based destruction.

item.title: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem
item.description: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem is an incremental-style tower defense game where you face an overwhelming number of orcs. Greet them with even more bullets, bombs and lasers!

item.title: The Medium
item.description: A third‑person psychological horror game where you explore both the real world and the spirit realm. As a medium drawn to a deserted resort, you’ll uncover dark secrets, confront echoes of trauma, and face the consequences of seeing more than one truth.

item.title: Thronebreaker: The Witcher Tales
item.description: Discover a brand new RPG from the creators of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. Facing an imminent invasion, Meve — war-veteran and Queen of Lyria and Rivia — is forced to once again enter the warpath and set out on a dark journey of destruction and revenge.

item.title: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian
item.description: The story of two protagonists as they rebuild their hometown and seek the hidden truth. Engage in timeline-based command battles and enjoy the easy-to-learn yet deeply engaging synthesis. Plus, take on shop management, explore random dungeons, and more!

item.title: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout DX
item.description: This DX edition includes new stories, playable characters(Agatha, Kilo, and Romy), and features that have been added to "Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout.

item.title: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Scorched Earth
item.description: The “Scorched Earth” expansion redefines the Eastern Front with a stunning arsenal for multiplayer, plus brand new single player content to complete the most brutal theater of the war. From the Siege of Sevastopol to the very last offensives of WWII in the east.

item.title: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Talvisota
item.description: The Talvisota expansion for CtA - GoH offers Finland and the unique northern fighting between 1939 and 1945, including a vast array of weaponry and unique game mechanics. The return of classic skirmishes also expands the Eastern Front with huge, replayable battles with a menacing, revamped AI.

item.title: FAIRY TAIL
item.description: Magic x Guilds x RPG = ”FAIRY TAIL”! Based on the fantasy adventure comic about Natsu, a Dragon Slayer of the rowdy Fairy Tail magician guild, and his unique group of friends battling against unusual and memorable enemies.

item.title: FAIRY TAIL 2
item.description: The final battle of FAIRY TAIL is about to begin

item.title: LEGO® Jurassic World
item.description: Following the epic storylines of Jurassic Park, The Lost World: Jurassic Park and Jurassic Park III, as well as the highly anticipated Jurassic World, LEGO Jurassic World™ is the first videogame where players will be able to relive and experience all four Jurassic films.

item.title: LEGO® Marvel Super Heroes 2
item.description: It's about TIME! Join your favorite Super Heroes and Super Villains from different eras and realities as they go head-to-head with the time-traveling Kang the Conqueror in the all-new, original adventure, LEGO® Marvel Super Heroes 2!

item.title: LEGO® MARVEL's Avengers
item.description: Avengers Assemble! The best-selling LEGO® MARVEL videogame franchise returns with a new action-packed, Super Hero adventure.

item.title: LEGO® Marvel™ Super Heroes
item.description: LEGO® Marvel™ Super Heroes features an original story crossing the entire Marvel Universe. Players take control of Iron Man, Spider-Man, the Hulk, Captain America, Wolverine and many more Marvel characters as they unite to stop Loki and a host of other Marvel villains from assembling a super-weapon capable of destroying the world.

item.title: Mahou Arms
item.description: Mahou Arms is an anime-inspired character-action hack and slash that tells the story of a magical girl paramilitary group fighting back against an unknown force invading Earth.

item.title: Monster Rancher 1 & 2 DX
item.description: The legendary monster training duology, “Monster Rancher” and “Monster Rancher 2”, is back!

item.title: Riders Republic
item.description: Jump into a massive multiplayer playground! Bike, ski, snowboard, or wingsuit across an open world sports paradise where the rules are yours to make or break.

item.title: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business
item.description: Unfinished Business is a new standalone adventure of RoboCop: Rogue City. OmniTower is their fortress, violence their language. Face elite mercenaries all the way to the top of the tower and enforce the law amidst the chaos!

item.title: Space Engineers - Economy 2 Pack
item.description: Space Engineers: Economy 2 Pack introduces a variety of decorative blocks designed to enhance and personalize your base. This pack features the new Safe Zone block, LCD Billboards, Floorplan Signs, and more.

item.title: Terra Invicta - Supporter Pack
item.description: The Terra Invicta Supporter Pack features the official game soundtrack by Breakdown Epiphanies, along with 4K wallpapers and a behind-the-scenes look at the game’s creation in an 80+ page digital artbook.

item.title: Broken Reality 2000
item.description: Get ready for a new adventure in the world of NATEM! Explore beautiful worlds, solve puzzles with new tools and meet wonderful people in this journey through a digital universe full of secrets in search of someone special.

item.title: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Finest Hour
item.description: From the early war Blitzkrieg campaign in France to the final fights in Germany, this DLC offers the Commonwealth faction on the Western front. Re- live the British Empire’s Finest Hour in spectacular historical detail, in multiplayer and singleplayer!

item.title: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Liberation
item.description: “Soldiers, Sailors, and Airmen of the Allied Expeditionary Force: you are about to embark upon the Great Crusade!” This DLC introduces the western front action in 1944, featuring the US faction, as well as German western front content.

item.title: Endacopia
item.description: Endacopia is a Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors.

item.title: Forsaken Realms: Vahrin's Call
item.description: Adventure awaits in this narrative driven fantasy action-RPG. The war-torn city of Vahrin stands before you on the brink of collapse and in desperate need of aid. As a mercenary in search of your next…opportunity, will you answer Vahrin’s Call?

item.title: Galactic Civilizations IV
item.description: Take command of a civilization that has just achieved faster-than-light travel in Galactic Civilizations IV, the newest entry in the award-winning space 4X strategy game series. Explore the galaxy, colonize worlds, shape cultures, make alliances, fight wars and pioneer new technologies.

item.title: Infinite Ruins
item.description: An incremental mining game where you manage golems, destroy blocks, unlock upgrades, and descend infinitely in search of ever more valuable resources.

item.title: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight
item.description: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

item.title: Prelude Dark Pain
item.description: Prelude Dark Pain is a Tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Assume the role of a local blacksmith named Soren, lead an uprising against the Order of the Ashen Crusade and save a world ravaged by war.

item.title: Terra Invicta - Dark Skies
item.description: Face the alien invasion in two new scenarios for Terra Invicta. Drop into a world shattered by nuclear fire a century ago, or rewind to 2003 and trade the rush to the stars for a slower fight on Earth.

item.title: Wireworks
item.description: Design your defenses, build your module board, and manage your wires. Combine signals and create synergies to empower your weapons and survive in this base-defense roguelike auto-battler.

item.title: Yet Another Zombie Defense HD
item.description: Top-down zombie shooter with tower defense elements featuring up to 4 players local and online co-op. Build your base by day, defend it by night, put your skills to the test to stay alive as long as possible! Darkness is coming. How long can YOU survive?

item.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu – Lost Explorers' Swords Pack
item.description: Enhance your armory with the Lost Explorers' Swords Pack and unlock two exclusive looks before heading out on expedition.
